title: The principal series 2-representation for $\mathrm{GL}_n\times\mathrm{GL}_n$ over a 2-dimensional local field
summary: Let $F=\mathbb{F}_q((u))((t))$ and $H=\mathrm{GL}_n(F)_L\times\mathrm{GL}_n(F)_R$. An ordered tuple $α=(α_1,\dots, α_n) $ defines a cross-$K_2$ multiplier on the doubled Borel. Twisted equivariantization then yields an exact uniformly smooth categorical principal series $2$-representation of $H$. For unitary parameters, the $\mathbb R((X))$-measure gives a positive Hom-valued formal Hermitian inner product on the spherical part. These constructions provide two-dimensional categorical analogues of selected unramified structures.
